tools.name: contextory_hooks_rebuild
contextory_workspace_get
tools.schema: z.object({ groupId: id.optional() })

tools.name: contextory_workspace_request_create
contextory_version_get
contextory_release_prepare
contextory_release_change
contextory_project_export
tools.schema:
z.object({
      section: z
        .enum([
          "overview",
          "records",
          "revisions",
          "history",
          "relationships",
          "code_files",
          "code_nodes",
          "code_edges",
          "code_imports",
          "jobs",
          "usage",
          "artifacts",
        ])
        .default("overview"),
      entityId: id.optional(),
      artifact: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
      offset: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
      limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(20),
    })

tools.name: contextory_catalog_get
tools.schema:
z.object({
      category: category.optional(),
      path: z.string().max(2000).optional(),
      query: z.string().max(4000).optional(),
      inventory: z.boolean().default(false),
      offset: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
      limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(20),
    })

tools.name: contextory_catalog_change
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      ...lease,
      action: z.enum(["create", "revise", "retire"]),
      id: id.optional(),
      expectedRevision,
      content: catalogContent.optional(),
      reason: text,
      migrationId: id.optional(),
    })

tools.name: contextory_catalog_review
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      id,
      expectedRevision: z.number().int().positive(),
      action: z.enum(["approve", "reject"]),
      reason: text,
    })

tools.name: contextory_catalog_migrate
contextory_context_get
tools.schema: z.object({ specId: id.optional() })

tools.name: contextory_entity_get
contextory_history_get
contextory_request_change
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      action: z.enum(["create", "revise"]),
      id: id.optional(),
      expectedRevision,
      title: z.string().min(1).max(300),
      description: text,
      reason: text.optional(),
    })

tools.name: contextory_spec_change
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      action: z.enum([
        "milestone",
        "create",
        "revise",
        "reopen",
        "complete",
        "block",
        "cancel",
      ]),
      id: id.optional(),
      parentId: id.optional(),
      expectedRevision,
      title: z.string().min(1).max(300).optional(),
      description: text.optional(),
      criteria: z.array(z.string().min(1).max(2000)).min(1).max(50).optional(),
      paths: z.array(z.string().max(2000)).max(100).optional(),
      dependencies: z.array(id).max(50).optional(),
      reason: text.optional(),
    })

tools.name: contextory_session_attach
tools.schema: z.object({ operationId, nativeSessionId: id.optional() })

tools.name: contextory_usage_get
tools.schema:
z.object({
      entityId: id.optional(),
      provider: z.enum(["codex", "claude", "bob"]).optional(),
      nativeSessionId: z.string().min(1).max(200).optional(),
      offset: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
      limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(20),
    })

tools.name: contextory_spec_lease
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      specId: id,
      expectedRevision,
      action: z.enum(["claim", "renew", "release"]),
      sessionId: id,
      leaseId: id.optional(),
    })

tools.name: contextory_finding_record
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      ...lease,
      id: id.optional(),
      expectedRevision,
      title: z.string().min(1).max(300),
      observation: text,
      impact: text,
      resolution: text.optional(),
      status: z.enum(["open", "resolved", "deferred"]),
      blocking: z.boolean().default(true),
      sources: z.array(source).max(30).default([]),
    })

tools.name: contextory_decision_record
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      ...lease,
      title: z.string().min(1).max(300),
      choice: text,
      rationale: text,
      alternatives: z.string().max(12000).default("None material"),
      consequences: text,
      supersedes: id.optional(),
      sources: z.array(source).max(30).default([]),
    })

tools.name: contextory_evidence_record
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      ...lease,
      title: z.string().min(1).max(300),
      detail: text,
      criteria: z.array(id).min(1).max(50),
      result: z.enum(["passed", "failed", "not_run"]),
      command: z.string().max(4000).optional(),
    })

tools.name: contextory_check_run
contextory_outcome_submit
tools.schema:
z.object({
      operationId,
      ...lease,
      expectedRevision: z.number().int().positive(),
      summary: text,
      issuesSummary: text,
      decisionsSummary: text,
      limitations: text,
      report: text,
      changelog: z.string().min(1).max(2000),
      catalog: z
        .object({ recordIds: z.array(id).max(200), explanation: text })
        .optional(),
      criteria: z
        .array(
          z.object({
            criterionId: id,
            evidenceIds: z.array(id).min(1).max(30),
          }),
        )
        .min(1)
        .max(50),
      commits: z
        .array(z.string().regex(/^[a-f0-9]{40,64}$/))
        .max(100)
        .default([]),
    })

tools.name: contextory_search
contextory_code_context_get
tools.schema:
z.object({
      codebaseId: id.optional(),
      query: z.string().min(1).max(4000),
      paths: z.array(z.string().max(2000)).max(20).default([]),
      specId: id.optional(),
      budgetTokens: z.number().int().min(512).max(6000).default(3000),
    })

tools.name: contextory_code_architecture_get
contextory_code_path_get
contextory_code_index_refresh
contextory_codebase_list
tools.schema: z.object({})

tools.name: contextory_codebase_change
tools.schema:
z
      .object({
        operationId,
        action: z.enum(["add", "remove"]),
        root: z.string().min(1).max(2000).optional(),
        name: z.string().trim().min(1).max(100).optional(),
        codebaseId: id.optional(),
      })
      .refine(
        (p) => (p.action === "add" ? Boolean(p.root) : Boolean(p.codebaseId)),
        "Add requires root; remove requires codebaseId.",
      )

tools.name: contextory_relationship_change
contextory_impact_get
tools.schema:
z.object({
      codebaseId: id.optional(),
      id: z.string().min(1).max(2500),
      direction: z.enum(["forward", "reverse", "both"]).default("reverse"),
      depth: z.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(5),
      limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(200).default(50),
    })

tools.name: contextory_flow_trace
contextory_flow_expand
tools.schema:
z.object({
      codebaseId: id.optional(),
      graphId: id,
      snapshotId: id,
      nodeId: id.optional(),
      offset: z.number().int().nonnegative().default(0),
      limit: z.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(30),
      limits,
    })

tools.name: contextory_report_export
